title: Hybrid cosmopsychism: subjects emerge, their experience is inherited

statements.text: Hybrid cosmopsychism combines strong emergence of subjects with weak emergence of their conscious states. Basic laws ensure that in certain conditions new subjects emerge from the universe, but they inherit phenomenal property instances that previously belonged to the universe, and give them back when they cease, as at the death of the organism.
